It has been claimed that even otherwise a similar trademark can be used by anyone for a substantial different product and no such trademark co-exist in the field of trade. 4.5) The defendant has stated that it has never used nor intended MUKESH by to use the plaintiff's trademark dishonestly and with knowledge as KUMAR GUPTA Date: GUPTA 2024.12.09 18:01:41 -0800 claimed and it has been used only in a descriptive manner nor as a trademark, which the defendant has even discontinued and restrained itself from the use of the word Nav Bahar in their business after receipt of the legal notice from the plaintiff's firm. Finally, it has been contended that there is absolutely no cause of action in favour of plaintiff and against the defendant and the suit filed by the plaintiff is nothing and an attempt to armstwist the defendant with an open threat that the plaintiff may implicate the defendant into false cases. 6 7. At the outset, in order to obtain an ad-interim injunction u/o XXXIX Rule 1 and 2 CPC the plaintiff has to satisfy the court on the trinity principle of strong prima facie case, balance of convenience and irreparable loss and injury which cannot be monetarily compensated.
